subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We have received your resume and cover letter and are currently in the process of reviewing all applicants. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will reach out to you shortly to discuss next steps. If you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to contact us. Best regards, [Company Name]
